blurb: Guests fish for sailfish, tarpon, mahi, snapper, and other species in Biscayne Bay, the Gulf Stream, and Miami's reefs. Trips are customized to skill level and goals, with options including kite fishing, live bait, tarpon, wreck and bottom fishing, shark fishing, jigging, and run and gun. The boat accommodates up to 4 anglers and includes premium tackle and live bait.
extraNote: Flexible scheduling, day and night trips seven days a week · Dinner Key Marina at 3400 Pan American Dr, Coconut Grove, Miami, FL 33133
